text:
Isaac: Office bracket update: my 15-seed just knocked out a 2-seed. I demand a parade.
Maya: HOW. teach me your dark powers. did you BS some matchup data? :eyes:
Tom: Noted: Isaac now officially cursed the common sense seeding model.
Harpreet: Reminder everyone — loser of the bracket pool owes winner a company-logo tee. stakes are real.
Leah: Wait is that official? I thought the prize was bragging rights and a bag of chips.
Isaac: I paid in chips last year, got crumbs, now I want a tee. who runs payouts? @Zoe you the merch czar?
Zoe: I can do tees. Suggest we document prizes in the pool thread so there's no mystery. Also: can we limit custom text to 2 words? corporate legal hates long slogans.
Maya: Tee or chip combo? I'm down for both.
Tom: Poll: Tee, Chips, or Both. leaguebot: poll created "Bracket pool prize?" Voting open 24h.
leaguebot: votes recorded: Maya both, Leah tee, Harpreet tee, Tom chips.
Harpreet: Also PSA: if anyone used auto-fill for picks, shame. manual entries only in my book.
Isaac: I definitely did manual. 6 hours of press-of-the-finger.
Leah: Small miracle pick story: my coworker guessed a mascot name at the watercooler and that's how I chose my sleeper. Luck = strategy.
Maya: Meme-time: posted a gif of a tiny dog tackling a much bigger dog in #random-memes. Highly accurate representation of 15-seed energy.
Tom: Logistics note: finals watch gathering on Friday? my apartment has a couch but I have 2 roommates who will judge our snack choices.
Zoe: Office courtyard might be better weather-permitting. I can reserve picnic tables.
Harpreet: Vote: courtyard vs Tom's couch. leaguebot: poll created "Finals watch venue? Courtyard / Tom's couch" Voting open 12h.
Isaac: One more bracket rule suggestion: tiebreaker = number of overtime games predicted correctly. Adds drama.
Leah: Love it. more drama = better office morale.
Maya: Can we also pledge no spoilers in #random until 10pm local? last year someone live-posted the score and I almost broke my monitor.
Tom: Agreed. No-spoiler rule in effect. If you must share, post in #sports-highlights with a spoiler tag.
leaguebot: Reminder: Bracket pool entry deadline in 6 hours. No spoilers channel policy auto-enforced until Sunday 22:00.
Zoe: I'll update the pool thread and add prize rules (tee + bag of chips if both win?) and post merch sizing form.
Harpreet: If I win, I want the tee to have my team's slogan: "Chaos Engineer".
Isaac: I call dibs on the first photo of winner wearing the tee for the Slack header.
Leah: Deal. Also small bet: loser buys coffee for the winner for a week. stakes accepted.
Maya: Coffee + tee + chips. This is now a multi-tiered prize economy.
Tom: Fine. I'm in. Good luck, small dogs.
Zoe: Officially documented. See you all at finals.
Isaac: Parade postponed until merch arrives.
